bodies.name: Inferal
bodies.line: Software is eating your business.
bodies.quote: Data should summon agents — not the other way around.
bodies.voice: Your systems know what happened. Inferal determines what happens next.
bodies.desc: Data infrastructure that replaces custom glue software with live, governed decision logic. Models that run your business. Grew out of Omnigres in 2025.
notes: Products: Relay (data movement), the Data Platform, Operational Models (ontologies) and Ontosome, a catalog of ontology modules.
Team: Yurii Rashkovskii (founder), Jeremy Tregunna, Mehdi Akiki.
From the Inferal blog: “Time Is Part of the Business Logic.”

bodies.name: Omnigres
bodies.line: Postgres as a Platform.
bodies.desc: Postgres as a complete application runtime: business logic, job queues, API endpoints, an HTTP server — inside or next to the database, instead of a constellation of services. 2022–2025; continued as Inferal (2025).

bodies.name: Strata
bodies.line: A 64-bit machine where memory is explicit I/O.
bodies.quote: The machine shows through instead of being hidden.
bodies.voice: The machine shows through instead of being hidden.
bodies.desc: A prototype instruction set and the small operating system that proves it. Local Stores instead of caches; transfers that complete with a tag; no interrupts.
notes: RTL, a C emulator with JITs, the StrataOS microkernel written in Strata assembly, Strata Forth, and a browser playground.
Local Stores, not caches: 64 KiB per core. Transfers carry completion tags: tget, tput, tany. Linear capabilities.
StrataOS has a tiled window server and a strip of core cells that pulse on context switches — this desktop is its cousin.

bodies.name: libycxx
bodies.line: An independent C++26 standard library.
bodies.quote: There is no list of tolerated failures.
bodies.voice: There is no list of tolerated failures.
bodies.desc: Freestanding core plus hosted library; import std; works. Version 0.1.0. Presented as a spec sheet, because that is what it is.
notes: 2,824 spec-derived tests, plus 17,098 external libc++ and libstdc++ tests run unmodified.
Implemented by AI agents directed by the author.

bodies.name: Flyology

notes: Libraries: HTTP, Postgres, QUIC, JSON, RDF, SIMD, TUI, NUMA, Cachelines, Allocators.
